changes: Added command-local EvidenceHashSnapshot capture/reuse and threaded it through DONE oracle, lifecycle readiness, phase gate, and session DONE pre-check consumers; updated focused freshness smoke coverage and documented the syndrome-preflight boundary.
usage: Run normal Lattice lifecycle commands; unchanged DONE/review gate invocations now reuse a coherent command-local hash binding when available and fall back to recomputation when not available.
expectedOutcome: DONE and review readiness checks avoid avoidable repeated whole-tree hash work inside one command while still rejecting stale or dirty material evidence.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-8963 --json passed all 31 configured commands with allPass=true and 12/12 verification intents covered. Focused smokes showed captureEvidenceHashSnapshot reusable=true/materialDirty=false, currentBinding reused, and stale supplied snapshot rejected after dirty material drift. lattice-review-delivery recorded PASS.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match: snapshot reuse works for unchanged command-local state, stale/dirty evidence remains blocked, and fallback behavior remains intact.
limitations: M1 intentionally adds command-local reuse only; it does not add persistent global hash caching, mtime/file-count freshness keys, fountain-code recovery, or parameterized recovery-runner fault injection.
pitfalls: Do not treat the snapshot as durable evidence across commands. Reuse is safe only when the current HEAD, material hash, storyFilesHash, and dirty-state checks still match.
